$comment: Single source of truth for the locale x route matrix. Read by scripts/resolve-locales.mjs, which writes the generated, git-ignored locales.active.ts that app.routes.ts / copy.ts / locale.service.ts import, and by scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs. FEATURE FLAGS: every non-default locale carries `enabled`, and the committed value is false, so a production build (GitHub Actions) ships English only: no /<prefix>/ routes, no switcher, no hreflang, no locale copy in the bundle. To work on a locale locally, set SPEAKWITH_LOCALES=de-DE (comma list, or `all`) in the environment or in the git-ignored .env; that override never reaches CI. Flip `enabled` to true here only when a locale is signed off for production. `prefix` is the URL segment ('' = unprefixed canonical English). Routes with `localized: false` (legal pages) ship English-canonical in every locale.
